description: This action commits its ncc bundle in dist/, and the Mend-hosted app blocks postUpgradeTasks, so no dependency PR can be merged until someone rebuilds the bundle locally. Nothing here automerges for that reason.
Consumers pin this action by SHA, so a poisoned dependency runs inside their jobs with a cache token: hence the npm release-age cooldown and the OSV alerts.

packageRules.description: The toolkit packages move as one: @actions/cache v6 pulls @actions/glob 0.7, and both need @actions/core v3 (all three are ESM-only).

prBodyNotes: ⚠️ `dist/` is what the runner executes and Renovate cannot rebuild it: run `npm ci && npm run build` and commit the result, or the `bundle-up-to-date` job stays red. See README → Build.
